description: Place a new order with one or more items, shipping details, and an optional coupon code.

user_id.description: ID of the user placing the order

unit_price.description: Price per unit at time of order

discount_override.description: Optional per-item discount amount that overrides any automatically applied discount

engraving.description: Text to engrave on the item

gift_wrap.description: Whether the item should be gift-wrapped

gift_message.description: Optional message to include with gift wrap

coupon_code.description: Optional coupon code to apply to the order

shipping.description: Shipping details including address, method, and recipient information

recipient_name.description: Full name of the shipment recipient

phone.description: Optional E.164 phone number for delivery notifications

address.description: Full street address of the delivery location

method.description: Shipping method: standard, express, or overnight

instructions.description: Optional special delivery instructions for the carrier

signature_required.description: Optional flag to require a signature upon delivery

same_as_shipping.description: If true, billing address is copied from the shipping address

name.description: Name as it appears on the billing account or card

method.description: Payment method: card, wallet, or buy_now_pay_later

save_for_future.description: Optional flag to save the payment method for future orders

fulfillment_preference.description: Optional preferences that govern how the order is fulfilled

allow_partial.description: Whether to allow partial shipment if not all items are available simultaneously

consolidate_shipments.description: Whether to consolidate items into as few shipments as possible

preferred_carrier.description: Optional preferred carrier name (e.g. FedEx, UPS, USPS)

gift_order.description: Optional flag indicating this is a gift order; suppresses price information in packing slip

metadata.description: Optional metadata about how and where the order was placed

source.description: Order origin: web, mobile, or api

ab_variant.description: Optional A/B test variant the user was assigned to

shipping.instructions: Leave at front door if no answer
